resources.string: This app is a private support tool for people who want to leave a habit behind and build healthier routines. Every step after this one is a simple choice.
What this app is and is not

It offers support and tools. It does not diagnose, treat or cure anything, and it cannot guarantee any result. It is not a replacement for professional or medical help. If you are in danger or in crisis, contact your local emergency services.
The app changes language right away. You can also use the language of your device.
Practical support for your recovery, without religious content.
The same support, with optional faith-based content added.
Why do you want to change? Write it in your own words. These reasons are only for you. You can skip this step.

This app has no account. Nothing you enter here is sent to anyone. During setup the app asks for no permissions and does not start any protection.
